usajmo-2021-q1.summary: Find all functions $f:\mathbb N\to\mathbb N$ such that, for all positive integers $a,b$, $$f(a^2+b^2)=f(a)f(b)\quad\text{and}\quad f(a^2)=f(a)^2.$$
usajmo-2021-q1.summaryZh: 求所有函数 $f:\mathbb N\to\mathbb N$，使得对任意正整数 $a,b$，都有 $$f(a^2+b^2)=f(a)f(b)\quad\text{且}\quad f(a^2)=f(a)^2.$$
usajmo-2021-q1.answer: The unique solution is $f(n)=1$ for every positive integer $n$.
usajmo-2021-q1.answerZh: 唯一解为：对每个正整数 $n$，均有 $f(n)=1$。

methods.title: Propagate the value 1 by a sum-of-two-squares identity
methods.titleZh: 利用平方和恒等式传递函数值 1
steps: The constant function $f\equiv1$ plainly works. We prove that every solution must be this function. From $f(a^2)=f(a)^2$ and the first equation, positivity gives, whenever $f(u)=f(v)=1$ and $u>v$, $$1=f(u^2+v^2)=\sqrt{f((u^2+v^2)^2)}.$$
Use $(u^2+v^2)^2=(u^2-v^2)^2+(2uv)^2$. Applying both functional identities yields $$1=\sqrt{f(u^2-v^2)f(2uv)}.$$ Both factors are positive integers, so $$f(u^2-v^2)=f(2uv)=1.$$
Putting $a=b=1$ in the first equation and using the second gives $f(2)=f(1)^2=f(1)$, hence $f(1)=f(2)=1$ because $f(1)$ is positive.

Apply strong induction. If $n=2k$, then $f(k)=f(1)=1$ and the preceding lemma with $(u,v)=(k,1)$ gives $f(2k)=1$. If $n=2k+1>1$, take $(u,v)=(k+1,k)$; both arguments are smaller than $n$, so the lemma gives $f((k+1)^2-k^2)=f(n)=1$. Thus $f(n)=1$ for all $n$.
stepsZh: 常值函数 $f\equiv1$ 显然满足条件。下面证明不存在其他解。若 $f(u)=f(v)=1$ 且 $u>v$，则由 $f(a^2)=f(a)^2$ 与第一式，并利用函数值为正整数，得到 $$1=f(u^2+v^2)=\sqrt{f((u^2+v^2)^2)}.$$
利用恒等式 $(u^2+v^2)^2=(u^2-v^2)^2+(2uv)^2$，再次代入两个函数方程可得 $$1=\sqrt{f(u^2-v^2)f(2uv)}.$$ 两个因子都是正整数，所以必有 $$f(u^2-v^2)=f(2uv)=1.$$
在第一式中取 $a=b=1$，再结合第二式，得到 $f(2)=f(1)^2=f(1)$。由于 $f(1)$ 为正整数，故 $f(1)=f(2)=1$。
作强归纳。若 $n=2k$，则归纳假设给出 $f(k)=f(1)=1$，在上面的引理中取 $(u,v)=(k,1)$，得到 $f(2k)=1$。若 $n=2k+1>1$，取 $(u,v)=(k+1,k)$；二者均小于 $n$，故引理给出 $f((k+1)^2-k^2)=f(n)=1$。因此对所有正整数 $n$ 都有 $f(n)=1$。

usajmo-2021-q2.summary: Outside an acute triangle $ABC$, construct rectangles $BCC_1B_2$, $CAA_1C_2$, and $ABB_1A_2$ on sides $BC,CA,AB$, respectively. Suppose $$\angle BC_1C+\angle CA_1A+\angle AB_1B=180^\circ.$$ Prove that $B_1C_2$, $C_1A_2$, and $A_1B_2$ are concurrent.
usajmo-2021-q2.summaryZh: 在锐角三角形 $ABC$ 的三边 $BC,CA,AB$ 外侧分别作矩形 $BCC_1B_2$、$CAA_1C_2$、$ABB_1A_2$。已知 $$\angle BC_1C+\angle CA_1A+\angle AB_1B=180^\circ.$$ 证明直线 $B_1C_2$、$C_1A_2$、$A_1B_2$ 共点。

figure.alt: An acute triangle with an exterior rectangle erected on each side.
figure.altZh: 锐角三角形三边外侧分别作一个矩形。

methods.title: Make the three rectangle circumcircles share a point
methods.titleZh: 证明三个矩形外接圆具有公共点
steps: Let $\omega_a$ be the circumcircle of rectangle $BCC_1B_2$ and $\omega_b$ the circumcircle of rectangle $CAA_1C_2$. Besides their common point $C$, let their second intersection be $P$.

Because $A,C,A_1,P$ are cyclic, $\angle APC=\angle AA_1C=\angle CA_1A$. Likewise, because $B,C,C_1,P$ are cyclic, $\angle CPB=\angle CC_1B=\angle BC_1C$. Hence, using directed angles, $$\angle APB=\angle CA_1A+\angle BC_1C=180^\circ-\angle AB_1B.$$ Therefore $A,B,B_1,P$ are cyclic, so $P$ also lies on the circumcircle of rectangle $ABB_1A_2$.

On $\omega_a$, the angle $\angle CPB_2$ subtends diagonal $CB_2$ of the rectangle, so it equals $90^\circ$. On $\omega_b$, $\angle CPA_1=90^\circ$. Thus both $PB_2$ and $PA_1$ are perpendicular to $PC$, which proves that $A_1,P,B_2$ are collinear.
Cycling the same argument gives $B_1,P,C_2$ collinear and $C_1,P,A_2$ collinear. Consequently the three required lines all pass through $P$.
stepsZh: 设 $\omega_a$ 为矩形 $BCC_1B_2$ 的外接圆，$\omega_b$ 为矩形 $CAA_1C_2$ 的外接圆。两圆除公共点 $C$ 外的另一个交点记为 $P$。

由 $A,C,A_1,P$ 共圆，$\angle APC=\angle AA_1C=\angle CA_1A$；由 $B,C,C_1,P$ 共圆，$\angle CPB=\angle CC_1B=\angle BC_1C$。使用有向角可得 $$\angle APB=\angle CA_1A+\angle BC_1C=180^\circ-\angle AB_1B.$$ 因而 $A,B,B_1,P$ 共圆，即 $P$ 也在矩形 $ABB_1A_2$ 的外接圆上。
在 $\omega_a$ 上，$\angle CPB_2$ 所对的是矩形的对角线 $CB_2$，故该角为 $90^\circ$。同理，在 $\omega_b$ 上有 $\angle CPA_1=90^\circ$。于是 $PB_2$ 与 $PA_1$ 都垂直于 $PC$，从而 $A_1,P,B_2$ 共线。
循环使用同一论证，得到 $B_1,P,C_2$ 共线以及 $C_1,P,A_2$ 共线。因此题设三条直线都经过 $P$。

usajmo-2021-q3.summary: An equilateral triangle $\Delta$ has side length $L>0$. Inside it are $n$ equilateral triangles of side length $1$ with pairwise non-overlapping interiors. Their sides are parallel to those of $\Delta$, but their orientation is opposite to that of $\Delta$. Prove that $$n\le \frac23L^2.$$
usajmo-2021-q3.summaryZh: 等边三角形 $\Delta$ 的边长为 $L>0$。在其内部画出 $n$ 个边长为 $1$、内部两两不相交的等边三角形；每个小三角形的边都与 $\Delta$ 的边平行，但方向与 $\Delta$ 相反。证明 $$n\le \frac23L^2.$$

figure.alt: An upward equilateral triangle containing several disjoint downward unit equilateral triangles.
figure.altZh: 一个向上的等边三角形内含若干内部不交的向下单位等边三角形。

methods.title: Replace every small triangle by its difference-body hexagon
methods.titleZh: 用差体六边形替换每个小三角形
steps: Use oblique coordinates along two sides of $\Delta$. Then $$\Delta=\{(x,y):x\ge0,\ y\ge0,\ x+y\le L\}.$$ A downward unit equilateral triangle is a translate of $$T=\operatorname{conv}\{(0,1),(1,0),(1,1)\}.$$ If its translation vector is $(p,q)$, containment in $\Delta$ gives $p,q\ge0$ and $p+q+2\le L$.

The centroid of this translate is $c=(p+2/3,q+2/3)$. Associate with it $$H=c+\frac12(T-T).$$ In the ordinary Euclidean plane, $H$ is a regular hexagon of side length $1/2$, hence has area $3\sqrt3/8$.

The six coordinate displacements from $c$ are $\pm(1/2,0)$, $\pm(0,1/2)$, and $\pm(1/2,-1/2)$. Thus every point of $H$ has positive coordinates, because its smallest possible $x$ or $y$ is at least $p+1/6$ or $q+1/6$. Also $$x+y\le p+q+\frac43+\frac12=p+q+\frac{11}{6}<p+q+2\le L.$$ Hence every associated hexagon lies inside $\Delta$.

The hexagons have disjoint interiors. Indeed, if two of them overlapped internally, the difference of their centres would lie in the interior of $H-H=T-T$. This is exactly the condition that the interiors of the corresponding two translates of $T$ overlap, contrary to the hypothesis.
Therefore the total area of the hexagons does not exceed the area of $\Delta$: $$n\cdot\frac{3\sqrt3}{8}\le\frac{\sqrt3}{4}L^2.$$ Cancelling $\sqrt3$ gives $n\le\frac23L^2$, as required.
stepsZh: 沿 $\Delta$ 的两条边建立斜坐标，则 $$\Delta=\{(x,y):x\ge0,\ y\ge0,\ x+y\le L\}.$$ 一个反向单位等边三角形是 $$T=\operatorname{conv}\{(0,1),(1,0),(1,1)\}$$ 的平移。若平移向量为 $(p,q)$，由其包含在 $\Delta$ 内可得 $p,q\ge0$ 且 $p+q+2\le L$。
该小三角形的重心为 $c=(p+2/3,q+2/3)$。为它配置集合 $$H=c+\frac12(T-T).$$ 在通常的欧氏平面中，$H$ 是边长为 $1/2$ 的正六边形，其面积为 $3\sqrt3/8$。
相对于 $c$，六个顶点的坐标位移为 $\pm(1/2,0)$、$\pm(0,1/2)$、$\pm(1/2,-1/2)$。因此 $H$ 中点的两个坐标均为正，因为最小的 $x,y$ 分别不小于 $p+1/6,q+1/6$。又有 $$x+y\le p+q+\frac43+\frac12=p+q+\frac{11}{6}<p+q+2\le L.$$ 所以每个六边形都位于 $\Delta$ 内。
这些六边形的内部两两不交。否则，若两个六边形内部相交，则其中心之差位于 $H-H=T-T$ 的内部；这等价于对应的两个 $T$ 的平移副本内部相交，与题设矛盾。
所以所有六边形的面积之和不超过 $\Delta$ 的面积：$$n\cdot\frac{3\sqrt3}{8}\le\frac{\sqrt3}{4}L^2.$$ 约去 $\sqrt3$ 即得 $n\le\frac23L^2$。

usajmo-2021-q4.summary: Three labelled pins $A,B,C$ start at the origin. In one move, one pin may be moved to an adjacent lattice point at distance $1$. Determine the least total number of moves needed to make triangle $ABC$ have area $2021$.
usajmo-2021-q4.summaryZh: 三个分别标为 $A,B,C$ 的图钉最初都位于坐标原点。每次操作可把一个图钉移动到距离为 $1$ 的相邻格点。求使三角形 $ABC$ 的面积等于 $2021$ 所需的最少总操作次数。

methods.title: Bound the area by the bounding box and match the bound
methods.titleZh: 用外接矩形估计面积并构造取到下界
steps: After $N$ moves, let the smallest axis-parallel rectangle containing the three pins have width $w$ and height $h$. Creating horizontal range $w$ requires at least $w$ horizontal moves in total, and similarly at least $h$ vertical moves, so $w+h\le N$.

Any triangle contained in this rectangle has area at most $wh/2$. (For fixed two coordinates the signed determinant is linear, so its maximum over the rectangle occurs at corners; equivalently, a diagonal divides the rectangle into two triangles of area $wh/2$.) Therefore $$2021\le\frac{wh}{2}\le\frac{(w+h)^2}{8}\le\frac{N^2}{8}.$$
Because $127^2=16129<8\cdot2021=16168$, the inequality forces $N\ge128$.

The bound is attainable. Move the pins to $$A=(-3,-18),\qquad B=(61,0),\qquad C=(0,46).$$ The total number of moves is $21+61+46=128$, while $$[ABC]=\frac12|64\cdot64-18\cdot3|=\frac{4042}{2}=2021.$$ Hence the minimum is $128$.
stepsZh: 完成 $N$ 次移动后，设包含三个图钉的最小轴平行矩形的宽、高分别为 $w,h$。形成横向跨度 $w$ 至少需要总计 $w$ 次水平移动，形成纵向跨度 $h$ 至少需要总计 $h$ 次竖直移动，因此 $w+h\le N$。
矩形内任意三角形的面积至多为 $wh/2$。（固定部分坐标后，有向面积行列式是线性的，最大值在矩形顶点处取得；也可用矩形对角线将其分成两个面积均为 $wh/2$ 的三角形来理解。）于是 $$2021\le\frac{wh}{2}\le\frac{(w+h)^2}{8}\le\frac{N^2}{8}.$$
该下界可以达到。把三个图钉分别移动到 $$A=(-3,-18),\qquad B=(61,0),\qquad C=(0,46).$$ 总移动次数为 $21+61+46=128$，且 $$[ABC]=\frac12|64\cdot64-18\cdot3|=\frac{4042}{2}=2021.$$ 因此最小值为 $128$。

usajmo-2021-q5.summary: A finite set $S$ of positive integers has the following property: for every $s\in S$ and every positive divisor $d$ of $s$, there is a unique $t\in S$ such that $\gcd(s,t)=d$ (possibly $s=t$). Determine all possible values of $|S|$.
usajmo-2021-q5.summaryZh: 有限正整数集合 $S$ 满足：对每个 $s\in S$ 以及 $s$ 的每个正因数 $d$，都存在唯一的 $t\in S$ 使得 $\gcd(s,t)=d$（允许 $s=t$）。求 $|S|$ 的所有可能值。

methods.title: Count gcd fibres and force every element to be squarefree
methods.titleZh: 计算最大公因数原像并迫使所有元素无平方因子
steps: The empty set works vacuously. Assume $S$ is nonempty. For fixed $s\in S$, the map $t\mapsto\gcd(s,t)$ sends $S$ bijectively onto the set of positive divisors of $s$. Hence $$|S|=\tau(s)\qquad\text{for every }s\in S.$$

We show that every $s\in S$ is squarefree. Suppose $p^e\Vert s$ with $e\ge2$. Under the above bijection, the number of elements $t\in S$ divisible by $p$ equals the number of divisors of $s$ divisible by $p$, namely $$\frac{e}{e+1}|S|.$$

The divisor $p$ of $s$ has a unique preimage $y\in S$ with $\gcd(s,y)=p$, so $p\Vert y$. Applying the same count to $y$, exactly half of the elements of $S$ are divisible by $p$. Thus $$\frac{e}{e+1}|S|=\frac12|S|,$$ which gives $e=1$, a contradiction. Hence every element is squarefree.

Consequently $|S|=\tau(s)=2^{\omega(s)}$ is a power of two. It remains to construct every such size. Choose $2k$ distinct primes $p_1,q_1,\ldots,p_k,q_k$ and let $S$ consist of the $2^k$ products obtained by choosing exactly one prime from each pair $(p_i,q_i)$.

For a fixed $s$ in this construction, each divisor $d$ of $s$ specifies exactly which chosen primes must also occur in $t$: keep the same prime in pair $i$ precisely when it divides $d$, and choose the other prime otherwise. This gives a unique $t$ with $\gcd(s,t)=d$. Thus every $2^k$ occurs; $k=0$ gives $S=\{1\}$.
stepsZh: 空集显然真空地满足条件。以下设 $S$ 非空。固定 $s\in S$，映射 $t\mapsto\gcd(s,t)$ 将 $S$ 双射到 $s$ 的所有正因数，因此对每个 $s\in S$ 都有 $$|S|=\tau(s).$$
证明每个 $s\in S$ 都是无平方因子的。反设 $p^e\Vert s$，其中 $e\ge2$。在上述双射下，$S$ 中能被 $p$ 整除的元素个数等于 $s$ 的因数中能被 $p$ 整除的因数个数，即 $$\frac{e}{e+1}|S|.$$
$s$ 的因数 $p$ 有唯一原像 $y\in S$，满足 $\gcd(s,y)=p$，所以 $p\Vert y$。对 $y$ 作同样计数，$S$ 中恰有一半元素能被 $p$ 整除。因此 $$\frac{e}{e+1}|S|=\frac12|S|,$$ 从而 $e=1$，矛盾。故 $S$ 的每个元素都是无平方因子的。
于是 $|S|=\tau(s)=2^{\omega(s)}$ 必为 2 的幂。下面构造所有这些大小：取两两不同的素数 $p_1,q_1,\ldots,p_k,q_k$，令 $S$ 为从每一对 $(p_i,q_i)$ 中恰选一个素数并相乘所得的全部 $2^k$ 个乘积。
固定构造中的 $s$。对 $s$ 的任一因数 $d$，在第 $i$ 对素数中，当且仅当 $d$ 含有 $s$ 所选的那个素数时，$t$ 也选同一个；否则 $t$ 选这一对中的另一个素数。这样唯一确定 $t$，且 $\gcd(s,t)=d$。所以每个 $2^k$ 都可实现；$k=0$ 时得到 $S=\{1\}$。

usajmo-2021-q6.summary: Let $n\ge4$. Find all positive real solutions $(a_1,\ldots,a_{2n})$ to the cyclic system $$a_{2k-1}=\frac1{a_{2k-2}}+\frac1{a_{2k}},\qquad a_{2k}=a_{2k-1}+a_{2k+1}\quad(k=1,\ldots,n),$$ where indices are taken modulo $2n$.
usajmo-2021-q6.summaryZh: 设 $n\ge4$。求循环方程组的所有正实数解 $(a_1,\ldots,a_{2n})$：$$a_{2k-1}=\frac1{a_{2k-2}}+\frac1{a_{2k}},\qquad a_{2k}=a_{2k-1}+a_{2k+1}\quad(k=1,\ldots,n),$$ 其中下标按模 $2n$ 理解。

methods.title: Eliminate the odd terms and compare the minimum and maximum
methods.titleZh: 消去奇数项并比较偶数项的最小值与最大值
steps: Write $b_k=a_{2k}$ and use cyclic subscripts. The odd equations give $$a_{2k-1}=\frac1{b_{k-1}}+\frac1{b_k},$$ while the even equations give $b_k=a_{2k-1}+a_{2k+1}$. Eliminating the odd terms yields $$b_k=\frac1{b_{k-1}}+\frac2{b_k}+\frac1{b_{k+1}}.\tag{1}$$

Let $m=\min b_k$ and $M=\max b_k$. At an index attaining $m$, equation (1) gives $$m\ge\frac2m+\frac2M.$$ At an index attaining $M$, it gives $$M\le\frac2M+\frac2m.$$ The two right-hand sides are equal, so $m\ge M$.
Since always $m\le M$, all the $b_k$ are equal to some positive number $r$. Substituting in (1) gives $$r=\frac4r,$$ hence $r=2$.
The odd equations now give $a_{2k-1}=1/2+1/2=1$ for every $k$. Direct substitution verifies that $(1,2,1,2,\ldots,1,2)$ satisfies the complete system, so it is the unique positive solution.
stepsZh: 记 $b_k=a_{2k}$，下标按循环方式理解。奇数下标方程给出 $$a_{2k-1}=\frac1{b_{k-1}}+\frac1{b_k},$$ 偶数下标方程为 $b_k=a_{2k-1}+a_{2k+1}$。消去所有奇数项，得到 $$b_k=\frac1{b_{k-1}}+\frac2{b_k}+\frac1{b_{k+1}}.\tag{1}$$
令 $m=\min b_k$，$M=\max b_k$。在取得最小值的下标处，由式 (1) 得 $$m\ge\frac2m+\frac2M.$$ 在取得最大值的下标处，同理有 $$M\le\frac2M+\frac2m.$$ 两个右端相同，所以 $m\ge M$。
另一方面恒有 $m\le M$，因此所有 $b_k$ 都等于同一个正数 $r$。代入式 (1)，得到 $$r=\frac4r,$$ 故 $r=2$。
再由奇数下标方程，$a_{2k-1}=1/2+1/2=1$。直接代入可验证 $(1,2,1,2,\ldots,1,2)$ 满足全部方程，因此它是唯一的正实数解。

methods.title: Sum the recurrence and force equality in Cauchy
methods.titleZh: 对递推式求和并利用柯西等号条件
steps: Retain equation (1) from Method 1 and put $S=\sum_k b_k$ and $T=\sum_k 1/b_k$. Summing (1) cyclically gives $$S=4T.$$ By Cauchy-Schwarz, $ST\ge n^2$, so $4T^2\ge n^2$ and therefore $T\ge n/2$.
Divide equation (1) by $b_k$ and sum over $k$. The cyclic cross terms combine to give $$n=\sum_k\left(\frac1{b_k}+\frac1{b_{k+1}}\right)^2.$$
Another application of Cauchy-Schwarz yields $$n\ge\frac1n\left(\sum_k\frac1{b_k}+\frac1{b_{k+1}}\right)^2=\frac{4T^2}{n},$$ hence $T\le n/2$.

Thus $T=n/2$, and equality holds in the last Cauchy inequality. Therefore all numbers $1/b_k+1/b_{k+1}$ are equal. Equality also holds in $ST\ge n^2$, so all $b_k$ are equal. Equation (1) then gives $b_k=2$, and the odd variables are all $1$.
stepsZh: 保留方法一中的式 (1)，并记 $S=\sum_k b_k$、$T=\sum_k 1/b_k$。对式 (1) 循环求和，得到 $$S=4T.$$ 由柯西不等式 $ST\ge n^2$，可得 $4T^2\ge n^2$，所以 $T\ge n/2$。
将式 (1) 除以 $b_k$ 后对 $k$ 求和。循环相邻交叉项合并为 $$n=\sum_k\left(\frac1{b_k}+\frac1{b_{k+1}}\right)^2.$$
再次使用柯西不等式：$$n\ge\frac1n\left(\sum_k\frac1{b_k}+\frac1{b_{k+1}}\right)^2=\frac{4T^2}{n},$$ 从而 $T\le n/2$。
因此 $T=n/2$，且最后一次柯西不等式取等；于是所有 $1/b_k+1/b_{k+1}$ 相等。同时 $ST\ge n^2$ 也取等，故所有 $b_k$ 相等。代回式 (1) 得 $b_k=2$，进而所有奇数项都等于 $1$。
